title: Record failed native BC probes, CPU velocity calibration and the larger standing audit
summary: Evaluation011 completes all three selected native probes without acquisition failure, and all three fail their unchanged numerical screens. Actual video review shows a nearly fixed stance without useful forward stepping. Ten probes and all 96 full Stage 2 cases remain missing. Fit003 completes CPU velocity-supervised calibration only; fit004 records a separate fresh 128-replica CPU identity. Both retain zero PPO updates and provide no native gait acceptance. The 128-replica raw audit passes every replica, with admission002 still under lead review. Evaluation012 has been dispatched as a separate native comparison; this record claims no completed result.
next: Assess the separate native candidate result, complete exact-source larger-batch admission review, and continue learning and full Stage 2 evaluation under the unchanged gates.
